Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1782 (Farnesyl pyrophosphate synthase). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, join target_dictionary on tid, and join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1782, standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and non-null pChEMBL value. Return the first 1000 rows ordered by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Do not deduplicate; keep all qualifying activity rows.
